name: The Quarter-Billion Club
description: Grow a startup into a company worth a quarter of a billion dollars within five years, against an incumbent with three times your capital. Borrowing is allowed — and lenders will grade you for it.

goals.description: Grow company value to $250M. Value rewards earnings, not size: a store earning less than investors require is worth less than it cost.
Earn an investment-grade credit rating (BBB or better). Ratings are reviewed every quarter once the company is a year old; interest cover, debt against earnings and company size all count.
